title: Quick Silky German Peaches Cobbler
description: A festive German dessert featuring peaches, with a floral and silky texture, made halal-friendly and perfect for any occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the flour, sugar, and baking powder.
Add the melted butter, eggs, vanilla extract, and salt to the bowl and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Arrange the peaches in a 9x9 inch baking dish and pour the batter over them.
Deglaze the peaches with a little water to remove any excess sugar.
Bake the cobbler in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the cobbler from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the cobbler warm, garnished with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream if desired.
